groups.groupDescription: Experience gameday in the most upscale club at MetLife Stadium. This seating area is a club/suite hybrid, featuring an indoor lounge as well as private outdoor decks with exceptional views of the field. Fans can enjoy a catering menu from celebrity chefs, an award-winning wine selection and exclusive amenities.

groups.groupDescription: Elevate your gameday experience in one of the traditional suites at MetLife Stadium. Enjoy unparalleled views of the field, indoor and outdoor seating options, a customizable menu from an award-winning culinary team and other premium amenities to enhance your experience.

groups.groupDescription: Entertain clients, family or friends in one of the largest suites at MetLife Stadium. These spacious suites feature indoor and outdoor seating options, a customizable menu from an award-winning culinary team and premium amenities. All suite guests can access the Corona Beach Club and the Miller Lite MVP Club.

groups.groupDescription: Everyone will feel right at home and enjoy this cozy indoor suite experience with an extraordinary view of the game. Also, enjoy direct access to the Corona Beach Club and the Miller Lite MVP Club.

groups.groupDescription: A seat in the EY Coaches Club is the best seat in the house. Located at midfield, the EY Coaches Club includes all-inclusive upscale food and alcoholic beverages as well as discounted platinum parking. Fans can watch the game from a private field-level patio directly behind the Jets bench with a view of players heading into the locker room. Fans have access to postgame field access for every day game.

These mid-field seats include access to the MetLife 50 club featuring all-inclusive upscale food and non-alcoholic beverages, discounted reserved parking and access to the private field-level patio directly behind the opposing team’s bench.

groups.groupDescription: Spend gameday in the TickPick Landing, the largest private hospitality space at MetLife Stadium, featuring an outdoor elevated platform with incredible views of the field as well as a climate-controlled indoor seating area. With a capacity for up to 250 people, this space is ideal for client entertaining or hosting a larger party. Guests in the TickPick Landing can take advantage of private bar service and catering options to enhance their gameday experience. For more info, and to purchase tickets in the TickPick Landing, please click HERE.
